description: Who should not take this drug? Lists the medical conditions a drug is recorded as contraindicated with (ci_with) in the US Veterans Health Administration MED-RT reference, via the U.S. National Library of Medicine RxClass (e.g. metformin: Renal Insufficiency, Liver Diseases, Acidosis), with MeSH condition IDs. Useful for students, carers and agents doing a first-pass reference check. It is a reference list, not the full warnings in a product label; drug-drug interactions are not covered, and anyone affected should check with a pharmacist or prescriber. (cost: 1 credit)

name.description: string, required, a generic or brand drug name (e.g. "metformin")

name: drug_contraindicated_conditions
